notes: FOUR NEW MIDGAME TURRETS in the Incinerator tier: Chain Spinner (six-barrel minigun, 8 shots/sec), Pulse Diffuser, Thermal Batter, and Shrapnel Driver - all max out in the 30-36k range.

UPGRADE REVAMP: every upgrade now boosts multiple stats at once (Damage + Optics, Damage + Cycler, Booster, and more) with the same max DPS as before; the upgrade button and the turret menu list exactly what each level adds.

SUPPORTS GOT REAL STATS: fabricator shows its cash rate (CASH +x/3S), command uplink shows its aura damage, null stabilizer shows its void cleanse - and every support upgrade now genuinely scales its signal.
STUN/AOE TURRETS display their current splash radius, damage, and effect values in the turret menu.
Blinding Light: the floating panels now track the cannon direction, the bolts become a thick double ray of light, and each shot flashes at the barrel mouths.
HOVER INFO: hovering over an ally's turret shows its stats and owner; hovering over an enemy shows name, tags, speed, armor, and a live health bar.
FIXED: leaking the final boss on the last wave is now a defeat, never a win.
FIXED: snapshots no longer let your selection stick to another player's turret.
Blinding Light's floating panels are now parented to the barrel - they rotate with the cannon, sit far in front, and separate on every shot.
Chain Spinner got its own minigun model: a six-barrel cluster that gains ammo feeds, side drums, and muzzle rings as it levels.
SEARCH BARS in the arsenal and the loadout screen: click the box to type, filter cards live, X/ESC clears, ESC again backs out.
